sentences.en: Those who dig a grave for others will fall therein.
sentences.zh: 为他人挖坟墓的人终将葬身其中。

sentences.en: Mennad wasn't able to dig himself out of his depression.
sentences.zh: 门纳德无法从抑郁中自拔。

sentences.en: We need to dig the truck out of the mud.
sentences.zh: 我们需要把卡车从泥里挖出来。
